construction.implementation_origin: New standalone implementation authored in the isolated build directory

input.dataset: Required label string and synthetic boolean
input.requirements: 1-100 objects: unique id, text, 1-30 unique case-insensitive evidence_terms, optional min_sources integer 1-100 (default 1)
input.documents: 0-100 objects: unique id, title, content (empty allowed)

output.success: schema_version, status=ok, dataset, review_method, disclaimer, summary, findings
output.finding: requirement_id, requirement_text, status=supported|gap, required_sources, supporting_document_ids, evidence, gap
output.error: schema_version, status=error, errors array of path/message

shared_schema.validation: One validate_input boundary for CLI and Python review. Strict object fields, bounded text/arrays, no duplicate IDs/terms; JSON loader rejects duplicate keys and non-finite values. File limit 2000000 bytes; aggregate document content limit 500000 characters.

cross_stage_handoffs: Single review stage: validated shared input -> literal evidence matching -> traceable findings and summary in one output object.

behavior.matching: Python re.IGNORECASE escaped literal substring matching; first occurrence per term, no token boundaries, stemming, normalization or semantic inference
behavior.coverage: Every term must occur within the same document. min_sources counts distinct supplied document IDs, not occurrences. Does not establish independent provenance or detect duplicate content.
behavior.traceability: Every document is evaluated per requirement; matches include exact quotes and zero-based, end-exclusive Python Unicode character offsets into original content. Missing terms are reported per document.
behavior.gaps: Insufficient complete documents produces a gap and source deficit. Missing evidence is not proof of noncompliance. Negated statements can match literal terms.
behavior.ordering: Input requirement/document/term order is preserved; deterministic and input is not mutated.
behavior.exit_codes: 0 for completed review even with gaps; 2 for validation, JSON, encoding, usage or file errors; one JSON object on stdout.
behavior.fixtures: Clearly labeled synthetic fictional procedures; no live data or providers.
behavior.llm: No LLM step; optional callable injection is not required for this literal reference implementation.

included: JSON CLI and reusable Python review function
Requirement/evidence coverage with exact source traces
Shared validation and synthetic unittest fixtures
excluded: Semantic truth, contradiction, negation or evidence-quality adjudication
PDF/OCR, external integrations, providers and document retrieval
Enterprise security, persistence, provenance verification or production deployment

test_outcomes.cli: passed: exit 0, one JSON object, status ok; 2 requirements, 1 supported, 1 traceable gap
test_outcomes.coverage: Normal coverage, source offsets, missing/empty documents, same-document cooccurrence, literal regex escaping and Unicode, determinism, invalid schema and limits, duplicates, malformed JSON/encoding/oversize input, CLI success and errors
